init: initialize the GeneraticAgent, validate LLM client availability, and start the agent run thread
build_dynamic_font_css: build a dynamic CSS block that scales the application font size by a percentage between 100% and 200%
render_sidebar: render a Streamlit sidebar widget for selecting the active LLM backend and switching between available chains
start_agent_task: start an agent task with a user prompt, initialize streaming state, and enqueue the task into the agent queue
render_streaming_area: render a streaming chat area with a stop button, update partial response segments, and finalize when the agent finishes
